Special programme on Mujibnagar Day
2014-04-17T00:00:00+06:00 | A Correspondent
https://www.thedailystar.net/special-programme-on-mujibnagar-day-20329

On the occasion of the historic Mujibnagar Day today (April 17), a special TV programme titled “Mujibnagar '71” will be telecast on Channel i at 6:40pm today. Liberation War Affairs Minister AKM Mozammel Haque, Meherpur lawmaker Farhad Hossain and Liberation War Affairs secretary K H Mahmud Siddiqui have taken part in the interviews. The programme is hosted by Nasiruddin Yousuff and produced by Raju Alim.
